top_signals.title: Why Government Bond Yields Are Rising and Causing Alarm
top_signals.summary: Government borrowing costs have been surging around the world as investors demand more compensation to entice them to hold longer-maturity debt. Yields on 30-year Japanese government bonds are near all-time highs at 4.19%, while 30-year UK government bond yields are at their highest since 1998. A Bloomberg gauge tracking government debt across the Group of Seven countries now yields its highest on average since September 2000.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Crypto treasury companies hit $340 billion market cap as altcoin DATs outperform
top_signals.summary: Cumulative market capitalization for these companies is up 10% since mid-August and hovers around $340 billion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
